quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #10
										  					
  

30 Questions • Passing Score 24

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must stop for other traffic.
Traffic is merging from another road. You should move over to give them space to merge safely.
Traffic is merging from another road. You should stay in the right lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from another road. You should move over to give them space to merge safely.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic will merge into your lane. Check your mirrors and side. Move to another lane if you can to give merging drivers a clear path.

questions.question: When turning left from a two-way street, where should you drive?

options.text: Near the right side of the road.
Near the centerline.
On the left side of the centerline.

questions.correctAnswerText: Near the centerline.
questions.explanation: For a left turn from a two-way street, stay in the lane closest to the centerline. Turn just before your car reaches the center of the intersection. Turn smoothly into the first legal lane available.

questions.question: Which statement is correct?

options.text: Use your left foot to brake.
Use your right foot for both braking and accelerating.
Always brake hard to stop quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use your right foot for both braking and accelerating.
questions.explanation: Use your right foot for both braking and accelerating. Press the brakes gently and gradually so your vehicle stops smoothly.

questions.question: When passing another vehicle, when is it safe to return to your lane?

options.text: When you cannot see the vehicle to your right.
When you see the vehicle's headlights in your rearview mirror.
After you pass the vehicle's front bumper.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you see the vehicle's headlights in your rearview mirror.
questions.explanation: Before moving back to your lane, make sure you have enough space. When you see both headlights in your rearview mirror, you have enough room to return safely.

questions.question: Hydroplaning happens when tires ride on water instead of the road. How do you prevent it in wet weather?

options.text: Use cruise control to keep a steady speed.
Slow down.
Move to the shoulder as soon as it rains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down.
questions.explanation: Hydroplaning happens when you drive too fast on wet roads. Slow down when the pavement is wet to prevent hydroplaning.

questions.question: After passing a vehicle, when can you safely move back to the right lane?

options.text: After about three seconds.
When you can no longer see the vehicle over your right shoulder.
When you can see the entire front of the vehicle in your rearview mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you can see the entire front of the vehicle in your rearview mirror.
questions.explanation: Return to your lane only when you can see both headlights of the passed vehicle in your rearview mirror. Always check your blind spots before moving back.

questions.question: What does excessive speed do?

options.text: Saves time so you arrive faster.
Helps you avoid obstacles.
Increases the risk of serious injury and death.

questions.correctAnswerText: Increases the risk of serious injury and death.
questions.explanation: Excessive speed is a major cause of crashes. It does not save time and leads to risky driving decisions.

questions.question: When merging onto the freeway, what speed should you drive?

options.text: At or near the speed of freeway traffic.
At the legal speed limit.
Slower than freeway traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: At or near the speed of freeway traffic.
questions.explanation: Enter a freeway at or near the speed of traffic, unless traffic is going faster than the legal speed limit.

questions.question: A steady yellow light means the light will turn red soon. If you are already in the intersection when it turns yellow, what should you do?

options.text: Stop.
Continue and clear the intersection safely.
Speed up to avoid an accident.

questions.correctAnswerText: Continue and clear the intersection safely.
questions.explanation: If you are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow, keep going and clear it quickly and safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Yield sign ahead.
Side road entering from the left.
Stop sign ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield sign ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a yield sign is coming. Begin to slow down when you see this warning.

questions.question: What is the speed limit in residential areas unless otherwise posted?

options.text: 25 mph
30 mph
20 mph

questions.correctAnswerText: 25 mph
questions.explanation: The speed limit in residential areas is 25 mph unless a sign shows otherwise. Watch carefully for children near schools, playgrounds, and homes. Drive slowly and carefully where children may be present.

questions.question: If a tire suddenly goes flat while you are driving, what should you do?

options.text: Pump the brake pedal several times quickly
Slow down gradually and do not brake
Press the brake pedal as hard as you can

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down gradually and do not brake
questions.explanation: If a tire goes flat, grip the steering wheel firmly and keep the car straight. Take your foot off the gas and do not brake. Let the car slow down on its own. Use the brakes gently only if needed. Pull off the road when it is safe.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT safe on the interstate?

options.text: Slower traffic keeps to the right
Change lanes without signaling
If you miss your exit, go to the next exit

questions.correctAnswerText: Change lanes without signaling
questions.explanation: Always signal before changing lanes. On the interstate, stay in the right lane if you are slower than other traffic. You cannot back up or make a U-turn on interstate highways. If you miss your exit, go to the next one.

questions.question: What is a driving distraction?

options.text: Anything that causes you to make quick movements while driving
Anything that takes your attention away from driving
Anything that makes you pay more attention to driving

questions.correctAnswerText: Anything that takes your attention away from driving
questions.explanation: A driving distraction is anything that takes your attention away from driving. Distractions can happen anywhere at any time. They can cause crashes that result in property damage, injury, or death.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn ahead
A road joins from the right
The road turns sharply right then sharply left

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right then sharply left
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you the road will turn sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: How can you know where traffic is behind you?

options.text: Check your rearview mirror often
Turn and look out your back window
Keep other vehicles out of your blind spots

questions.correctAnswerText: Check your rearview mirror often
questions.explanation: Check your rearview mirror often to know where traffic is behind you.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Road construction ahead
The road curves left then right
The road curves right then left

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right then left
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road will curve right, then curve left. Slow down to stay safe on the curves.

questions.question: What does an orange and red triangular sign on a vehicle mean?

options.text: The vehicle has the right-of-way
Slow-moving vehicle
Shoulder work ahead

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow-moving vehicle
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles display an orange and red triangle on the back. These include farm tractors, road maintenance vehicles, and animal-drawn carts.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down or stop
Stop if necessary
You must come to a complete stop

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the marked line. If there is no line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop before the intersection where you can see oncoming traffic. Proceed only when it is safe.

questions.question: What do signs with orange backgrounds mean?

options.text: General warning signs
Construction and maintenance warning signs
Regulatory signs

questions.correctAnswerText: Construction and maintenance warning signs
questions.explanation: Orange signs are used only for construction and maintenance warnings.

questions.question: When an emergency vehicle uses its siren and flashing lights, you must yield by:

options.text: Moving to the right edge of the road as far as possible and stopping.
Moving to the right lane and driving slowly until it passes.
Stopping right away, even if you are in an intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Moving to the right edge of the road as far as possible and stopping.
questions.explanation: You must give the right-of-way to any emergency vehicle with its siren and lights on. Move to the right edge of the road and stop. Do not stop in an intersection. You can move again after the emergency vehicle passes.

questions.question: A U-turn is not allowed:

options.text: In a parking lot.
On or near a curve or hill.
On a straight road where you can see 500 feet ahead in both directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: On or near a curve or hill.
questions.explanation: Never make a U-turn on or near a curve or hill. You cannot see oncoming traffic or pedestrians clearly. This can cause a crash.

questions.question: In a car on a highway, it is:

options.text: Illegal to drink from or have open alcohol containers.
Legal to drink alcohol if you are not the driver.
Legal to drink alcohol while driving as long as you are not drunk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Illegal to drink from or have open alcohol containers.
questions.explanation: It is illegal to drive while under the influence of alcohol. Drivers and passengers cannot have open alcohol containers in a moving car.

questions.question: Double solid yellow lines in the center of a road mean passing is:

options.text: Allowed from both directions.
Allowed only from your direction.
Not allowed from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Not allowed from either direction.
questions.explanation: A double yellow centerline means no cars from either direction can cross it to pass.

questions.question: When merging onto a freeway, you should drive:

options.text: At or near the speed of freeway traffic.
5 to 10 mph slower than freeway traffic.
At the posted freeway speed limit.

questions.correctAnswerText: At or near the speed of freeway traffic.
questions.explanation: When entering a freeway, drive at or near the speed of traffic already on the freeway.

questions.question: A broken yellow line down the center of a road means:

options.text: A construction zone is ahead.
Passing is not allowed from either direction.
Passing is allowed from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing is allowed from either direction.
questions.explanation: Broken yellow lines between lanes of traffic mean any driver can pass when there is no oncoming traffic.

questions.question: A broken yellow line between two lanes of traffic means:

options.text: Both lanes have traffic going in the same direction.
Passing is allowed when it is safe.
Passing is not allowed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing is allowed when it is safe.
questions.explanation: Dashed yellow lines separate lanes with traffic moving in opposite directions. You can pass when there is no oncoming traffic in the passing lane.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Pedestrians are walking along the road ahead.
Pedestrians may cross ahead.
Pedestrians cannot cross here.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pedestrians may cross ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign alerts drivers that pedestrians may be crossing. If a pedestrian is in the crosswalk, you must stop and stay stopped until they leave.

questions.question: Roads are slippery when rain first starts. On a slippery road, you should:

options.text: Avoid turning and stopping quickly while driving fast.
Test your tires' grip while driving uphill.
Look closer to your vehicle instead of farther ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid turning and stopping quickly while driving fast.
questions.explanation: Wet roads reduce tire grip. Drive more slowly on wet roads than on dry roads. Avoid quick turns and stops to prevent skidding.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Pedestrian crossing.
School crossing.
Jogging trail.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pedestrian crossing.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign alerts drivers to watch for people crossing the road.
